defects.title: minFlux and maxFlux cannot be requested together with a rounded polytope
defects.trigger: [samples, P, minFlux, maxFlux] = chrrSampler(model, [], 5, [], P) with P the roundedPolytope of a previous call

defects.expected: the flux minima and maxima stored in roundedPolytope

notes: Lead decision 2026-11-16: a documented output left unassigned on a documented input is an error (precedent printCouplingConstraints), so QUARANTINED; reproduction: rng(1); model = createModel({'R_in';'R1';'R2';'R3';'R_outB';'R_outC'}, {'in';'r1';'r2';'r3';'ob';'oc'}, {' -> A';'A -> B';'A -> C';'B -> C';'B -> ';'C -> '}, [], zeros(6,1), 10*ones(6,1)); model.c = [1;0;0;0;0;0]; [~, P] = chrrSampler(model, 20, 30); [s, P2, mn, mx] = chrrSampler(model, 5, 2, [], P) -> error 'Output argument "minFlux" (and possibly others) not assigned'. Confined to the 4-output call with a roundedPolytope; sampleCbModel uses two outputs. The full passing tier 3 test written before the quarantine is kept by the helper. Callee observation (fluxVariability/preprocess, not this function): with the model above plus model.C = [0 1 1 0 0 0]; model.d = 8; model.dsense = 'L'; model.ctrs = {'c1'}; [s, ~, mn, mx] = chrrSampler(model, 5, 20, 1, [], false, 50) gives mx(1) = 10 for R_in although R_in = R1 + R2 <= 8 (mx(2) = mx(3) = 8, mn(1) = 4, all samples satisfy R1 + R2 <= 8; gurobi and glpk, MATLAB R2025a). Other callee observations: toRound 2 errors 'The specified key is not present in this container.' at ConvexBody.round line 354 (external Volume-and-Sampling via preprocess line 290); useFastFVA true errors 'x0 not interior' (mve_solver_cobra line 29) after a parallel pool start; a model without metabolites stops in glpk ('A cannot be an empty matrix'). Indirect run-time callee for every pre-processing call: src/analysis/FVA/fluxVariability.m (BLOCKED) through the external preprocess.
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproduction: the documented outputs minFlux/maxFlux are never assigned when a roundedPolytope is passed); severity raised to error by the lead (precedent printCouplingConstraints)

notes: Reproduction (MATLAB R2025a): model = createModel({'Liver_EX_xyz(e)_[bc]'}, {'x'}, {'Liver_xyz[e] <=> xyz[bc]'}); P = struct('sex','male','CardiacOutput',5000,'Hematocrit',0.4,'GlomerularFiltrationRate',100,'CSFFlowRate',0.35,'CSFBloodFlowRate',0.5,'UrFlowRate',2000,'bodyWeight',65,'MConDefaultBc',20,'MConDefaultCSF',20,'MConDefaultUrMax',20,'MConDefaultUrMin',0,'MConUrCreatinineMax',1.2,'MConUrCreatinineMin',0.5,'bloodFlowPercCol',[2 3],'bloodFlowOrganCol',1); P.bloodFlowData = {'Organ','B','B';'Liver',0.25,0.27}; P.OrgansWeights = {'Brain',1400,2}; out = physiologicalConstraintsHMDBbased(model, P, {'Liver_EX_xyz(e)_[bc]'}); out.lb is -21.6 (same as without the third input). The defect is confined to calls with a non-empty ExclList (third input); the same defect was reported for physiologicalConstraintsHMDBbasedTEMP in wave 15-b. Coverage: MATLAB R2025a's coverage plugin reports 0 executable lines for this file (CodeCoveragePlugin XML has an empty <lines/>, also for an ASCII-only copy), so lines/missed are 0/[]. With the profiler, the full test (46-reaction hand-built model, male/female, HMDB and direct input for bc/csf/u, defaults, ExclMet, inverted-bound resets, brain O2) executed every statement except 914-934 (inside if 0), 956 and 965 (unreachable: brain_weight is always a cell). Expected bounds were worked out by hand from the formulas and the HMDB rows. The full passing test written before the quarantine (same file name) is kept in the helper's scratch folder; the lead may restore it if the severity is lowered.
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproduction, measured with the profiler: ExclList is ignored for blood exchanges outside the kidney)
